about: Gateway provider credentials sourced from Secret Manager only (GR-6). Mirrors the shape of infra/terraform/modules/web-surface/auth-env.json: this file names the secret id, the env the runtime injects it as, and the constant the reading code defines for it. It never carries a value. infra/terraform/main.tf projects each entry into the named service's Cloud Run revision (modules/control-plane-service), gated on the flag named in `gate` (infra/feature-flags/registry.yaml), and gateway/providers/nous.py defines the reading constant.

secrets.source: operator-supplied Nous Research portal API key (https://portal.nousresearch.com), created in Secret Manager and versioned by the operator; never committed.
secrets.why: gateway/providers/nous.py (NousProvider, issue #1559/#1748) authorizes its OpenAI-compatible chat/completions call with this key as a bearer token; an absent key means no Authorization header is sent, so the call fails at the provider with 401 rather than shipping a literal (issue #1748).
